description:
Schedule a one-time re-ask of prompts N days from now, to see whether published fixes got the brand cited — typically get_fix_plan's verify_prompts with its audit_id as baseline. Nothing runs or bills now.

Billing: free to schedule; when it runs, 5–12¢ per engine check (33¢ a prompt on the four defaults, ai-mode 10¢) per prompt × engine answered; no playbook. estimated_cost_cents assumes every check answers; short on credit then, only what the balance covers runs.

Limits: 25 waiting per workspace, 25 prompts each; cancel_recheck removes one.

When to call: after fixes are published, to learn later whether engines now cite the brand (days to weeks; an answer now: check_brand_citation).

Runs on the daily 06:00 UTC pass at or after run_at, with fresh answers; read it with get_recheck.

Returns { recheck_id, status: "scheduled", site_id, domain, run_at, prompts, engines, checks, baseline: {audit_id, completed_at} | null, prompts_without_baseline (after-only results), estimated_cost_cents, charged_cents: 0, note? }.

baseline_audit_id.description: Audit to compare against, e.g. get_fix_plan's audit_id. Default: the site's newest completed audit that asked these prompts; a prompt × engine it didn't answer is compared with the newest earlier audit that did.

days.description: Days from now to run it, 1–90. Default 14.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Defaults to the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

label.description: Optional note, e.g. "after FAQ rewrite on /pricing".

prompts.description: Prompts to ask again (max 25), e.g. get_fix_plan's verify_prompts. Omit to re-ask the baseline audit's prompts.

name: schedule_recheck
title: Schedule a one-time recheck of prompts after publishing fixes
